Why experience matters

AI is the accelerator. Experience is the engine.

Anyone can generate a draft. Turning it into a product that ships, scales and survives real stakeholders takes years of seeing it done end to end.

01

We see the whole picture

Strategy, design, build, QA, launch and support. After 15+ years across every stage, I know how each decision upstream shows up downstream.

02

We know what to ask AI for

AI is only as good as the person directing it. Experience is knowing the right problem, the right constraints and when the output is wrong.

03

We have shipped under real constraints

Banks, insurers and startups: compliance, accessibility, stakeholders, budgets and deadlines. The unglamorous parts that make products actually launch.

04

One accountable lead

No hand-offs between five vendors. One senior partner owns the outcome from first workshop to live product.

A few projects from across insurance, finance and entertainment.

Entertainment · Music streaming

Playmi: a music streaming platform

Product design, project management and marketing for a streaming service across web, iOS and Android, built around independent artists and DJs.

Founder-led product design & delivery

  • One design language across the web player and the iOS/Android apps, designed in Figma.
  • Home feed with featured track, new releases, trending charts and a live "all-time heaters" rail.
  • Album, artist and player screens for mobile, with credits that link through to artist pages.
Visit playmi.ca
Events · Ticketing

Ticketmi: event discovery & ticketing

A dark-first events marketplace where people discover, RSVP and buy tickets, and organizers create events.

Product design & front-end

  • Event cards with category, date, venue, price and clear status badges such as Closed.
  • Fast search across events, artists and venues, plus a Find My Tickets lookup.
  • Free RSVP and paid ticket flows, organizer event creation, and a light/dark toggle.
Visit ticketmi.ca
Insurtech · Founder-led

ClientDesk: a digital insurance platform

Designed and built an end-to-end platform that puts insurance in consumers’ hands while giving brokers a modern workspace.

Founder, CTO & lead designer · 2015–2018

  • iOS/Android app and broker dashboard, from wireframes and user-flow maps to the final UI.
  • Hybrid app on Ionic/Angular and a React dashboard, backed by a MEAN stack on AWS.
  • Broker advisory group and A/B testing to find and fix real pain points.
  • Used by 20,000+ customers.
Finance · Insurance

BMO Life portal & app pilot

Wireframes and design mocks for a policy-management portal and companion mobile app.

UX/UI designer

  • Self-service flows such as change of beneficiary and change of address.
  • Clear policy summary on mobile with the key numbers up front.
  • Mocks delivered for stakeholder review and approval.
Film · Interactive campaign

Scream 4: the movie site (scream4.ca)

A large-scale promotional site for the Scream 4 release, built at a time when full-screen video backgrounds in HTML5 were still new.

Designer & front-end developer

  • One of the early interactive HTML5 sites to use full-screen video backgrounds.
  • Full-screen cinematic video as the backdrop, with a characters section and a pause/play control.
  • A “Make a Scream face” fan interactive with sharing via Twitter and Facebook.

How I work

The 3-T formula.

01

Test

Start small. Use AI to prototype in hours, then validate with real users and real data before committing.

02

Tune

Let the evidence steer. Refine what works and cut what does not earn its place.

03

Try again

Iterate quickly with AI in the loop and ship improvements in the open.

About

Rajeev Kugan

A creative leader specializing in SaaS-based, end-consumer product delivery, now building with AI at the centre of the workflow. For 15+ years I’ve challenged the status quo while keeping stakeholders’ wants and needs at the centre, working across Canada’s largest banks, insurers and brands.

That experience is the point: AI speeds up the work, but knowing the full end-to-end scope is what makes it land.

I’m a creator at heart who adopted design, development, marketing, photography and cinematography as ways to bring a vision to life.
